pages.text:
Burns coal, charcoal and coal blocks straight into FE: {fe:40} FE/t, {fe:32000} FE per coal. It pauses while its FE buffer is full.
Simple and cheap, but a Firebox with a Thermoelectric Plant gets about twice as much from each coal.
Energy upgrades raise the FE per fuel; Speed upgrades burn faster.
Charcoal leaves Wood Ash in the ash slot half the time: take it out by hand or through an Output face.
